role: Planned-route model built from a GPX-style track (trackpoints, cumulative distance, climbs, totals) plus RouteProgress, which projects a live fix onto the route and reports progress and the next climb.
types: Route.Climb: struct Codable/Hashable — climb segment with optional roadName
toplevel: Route and Route.Point use synthesized Codable; Climb has custom CodingKeys and decoder for old saved routes lacking roadName.

flags.text: Doc comment says the next climb is the first climb that ENDS beyond the current position, but RouteProgress.compute picks the first climb whose START is beyond it, so while on a climb nextClimb is the following climb.
totalAscentMeters/totalDescentMeters sum raw unsmoothed GPS altitude deltas, so GPS altitude noise inflates both totals (climb detection smooths, totals do not).

units.does: Climb length = end - start distance along route.
Memberwise initializer for Climb with roadName defaulting to nil.
Decodes a Climb, requiring the four numeric fields and decoding roadName only if present.
units.entry: Decodable synthesis use: JSONDecoder decoding SavedRoute.enrichedClimbs / Route from saved_routes.json and other Codable stores.

units.does: Builds a Route from a CLLocation track: empty Route for <2 points, else trackpoints with altitude, cumulative distance, raw ascent/descent, detected climbs and total distance.

branches.effect: build full route; otherwise return empty(named:)
total distance = last cumulative; ?? 0 fallback (unreachable since cumulative starts [0])

units.does: Returns a Route with a fresh UUID, the name and no track/climbs/totals.
Computes cumulative distance per trackpoint plus raw ascent and descent from consecutive altitude differences.

branches.effect: append cumulative distance and altitude delta
add to ascent; else add |dh| to descent (zero adds 0)

units.does: For tracks of >=5 points, smooths altitudes with a 5-point moving average, finds rising runs, and keeps those qualifying as climbs (>=30 m gain, >=3% grade).
Returns index ranges where the smoothed profile rises, ignoring flat steps; a run closes at the first falling step and an open run is closed at the last index.

branches.cond: falling and a run is open

units.does: Turns an index range into a Climb when gain >=30 m over positive length with average grade >=3%; else nil.
Centered moving average of width `window` over interior points; edges keep raw values; returns input unchanged when window<=1 or values not longer than window.

Projects a fix onto the route: nil for an empty route; otherwise nearest trackpoint (continuity-aware), distance along, percent complete, metres to finish, and the first climb starting after the current position with distance to it.

branches.cond: route has trackpoints and cumulative distances

flags.text: RouteProgress.compute / nearestPointIndex / continuityWindow (loop start-vs-finish and out-and-back continuity logic) have no tests: grep 'RouteProgress' in EmuquTests finds nothing.

units.does: Returns the trackpoint index nearest the fix: within the continuity window around the previous index if the best there is <=100 m, else the earliest index within 25 m of the global minimum.

branches.cond: a continuity window exists (previous index valid)

branches.effect: best = min; ?? 0 when empty (unreachable: caller guards non-empty)
return it; ?? 0 fallback unreachable since best itself qualifies

units.does: Returns the index range from ~100 m behind to ~1000 m ahead of the previous match, or nil without a valid previous index.

branches.effect: lo; ?? 0 fallback (unreachable since previous itself qualifies)
hi; ?? count when the lookahead runs past the route end
